title: Tesla Solar Roof is on life support as it pivot to panels
summary: Tesla is abandoning its Solar Roof product (integrated solar shingles) and pivoting back to traditional solar panels due to ongoing challenges with installation complexity, cost, and durability issues. The company, once promising to revolutionize rooftop solar with aesthetically seamless tiles, has struggled to make the product viable despite years of effort.
problem_solved: This case study examines why Tesla's ambitious attempt to make solar roofing mainstream failed to achieve commercial viability.
why_valuable: It demonstrates the real-world challenges of hardware innovation and the importance of product-market fit, even for well-funded companies.
